items.title: What SafeTouch is
items.body: SafeTouch is an educational app that teaches children aged 6 to 11 about body safety: personal space, safe and unsafe touch, saying NO, and trusted adults. Lesson 1 shows which parts of the body are private using coloured dots on a clothed cartoon character (the parts a swimsuit covers); nothing is ever shown undressed. Lesson 4 gently asks your child whether anyone makes them feel unsafe or worried. It does not diagnose, investigate or replace child-protection services. If you are worried about a child, call the free Child Helpline 116 or go to an Isange One Stop Centre.

items.title: How your child uses it
items.body: Your child uses SafeTouch with an adult nearby. The app uses the camera to show Keza, the guide character, in your room, and the microphone while your child practises saying NO. The camera picture and the sound are never recorded, saved or sent.

items.title: What SafeTouch keeps about your child
items.body: On this phone only: an age group (6-8 or 9-11), lesson progress and badges, the first name or nickname your child gives their guide in the room (they can skip it), and the kinds of people your child picks in lesson 4 (the grown-ups they trust, and anyone who makes them feel unsafe). Never your child's photo, location or voice, and never the names of the people they pick. You can see their answers in Grown-ups > My child. If a grown-up switches on anonymous sync in Settings, lesson results are sent with a random device number; the name and the answer about feeling unsafe are never sent.

items.title: What SafeTouch keeps about you
items.body: Your name, phone number, email address and country, and the date you agreed. They are used only to confirm this consent (we email you a 6-digit code and a copy of what you agreed) and to contact you about it. They are kept on the SafeTouch server, apart from your child's progress, and are never sold or shared.

items.title: Your rights
items.body: You can withdraw your consent at any time in Grown-ups > Settings > Withdraw consent. This deletes your details from the server and your child's progress from this phone and the server. You can ask to see or correct your details. Under Rwanda's Law N° 058/2021 on the protection of personal data and privacy, a parent or legal guardian gives consent for a child under 16.

items.title: The SafeTouch study
items.body: SafeTouch is part of a capstone research project at the African Leadership University. Taking part is voluntary, and saying no or stopping later has no consequences for you or your child.
